# llm-wiki graph engine

This directory contains the browser bundle of `@llm-wiki/graph-engine` from
https://github.com/sdyckjq-lab/llm-wiki-skill at commit `efa2294`.

The upstream project is licensed under the MIT License. The license text is
included in `LICENSE`. The bundle is kept as a versioned same-origin asset so
the knowledge graph can run without a third-party CDN dependency.
